purpose: Alias proposals for Agent-5 findings that cannot be applied with the current tooling because correcting a published child row role retires its identity.
method: For each flagged base row whose Arabic and Persian renderings are published as separate single-language child rows, the two published ids and their code-point lengths are listed with the alias entries a supported V1-to-V2 mapping migration must carry.
note: No proposal is applied here. No source text is quoted. These are structural mappings, not translation or scholarly approval.
